title: Excellent practice
content: I have had need to see the surgery numerous times recently. The reception, nurses and doctors have been extremely professional and caring on all of my visits. I think The Grange offers a very high level of care for which I am very grateful.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
